title: Designing Social Robots with Ethical, User-Adaptive Explainability in the Era of Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation of cognitive ableism, analyzing how foundation models trained on neurotypical data may misinterpret neurodivergent behaviors and pathologize users in human-robot interactions.

Qualitative analysis of systemic epistemic exclusion, discussing how foundation models centralize knowledge authority and marginalize non-hegemonic ways of knowing, such as those of Indigenous and underrepresented linguistic communities.
